title: Model Catalog Expansion (v0.51.0)
description: Model Catalog Expansion in Soup CLI v0.51.0. 26 new recipes (GPT-OSS 20B/120B, GLM 4.6/5, Kimi K2/K2-Thinking (both marked unavailable in v0.77.0), MiniMax M2, QwQ-32B, QVQ-72B, Granite 4, LFM2, Cogito v2 (its recipe was removed in v0.76.0), Mistral Small/Medium 3.5, Magistral/Devstral/Ministral, MedGemma, EmbeddingGemma, LLaVA-Next, InternVL 3.5, Voxtral, Baichuan 2, Qwen-Image, DeepSeek-OCR, Paddle-OCR-VL). MULTIPACK_ARCHITECTURES 18 → 38. Alternative hubs: hf | modelscope | modelers.

blocks.html:
Model Catalog Expansion (v0.51.0)

26 new recipes, catalog 80 → 106. (This is the v0.51.0 snapshot. The catalog is 171 recipes at v0.77.0; see Recipes for the current list.)

New families

GPT-OSS 20B/120B, GLM 4.6 / 5, Kimi K2 / K2-Thinking, MiniMax M2, QwQ-32B, QVQ-72B, Granite 4, LFM2, Cogito v2, Mistral Small 3 / Medium 3.5, Magistral / Devstral / Ministral, MedGemma, EmbeddingGemma, LLaVA-Next, InternVL 3.5, Voxtral, Baichuan 2, Qwen-Image, DeepSeek-OCR, Paddle-OCR-VL.

(Changed in v0.76.0: the cogito-v2-sft recipe was removed, because no compatible replacement base exists for its shipped definition, and several of the others were edited to correct a base model ID, for example glm-4.6-sft, kimi-k2-sft, granite-4-sft, internvl-3-5-sft and voxtral-sft.) (Changed in v0.77.0: kimi-k2-sft and kimi-k2-thinking-grpo are marked unavailable, because a resident Kimi K2 load is refused at config load on Transformers 5.x; soup recipes use exits 3 for both, see Recipes.)

MULTIPACK_ARCHITECTURES: 18 → 38

The Multipack allowlist now spans 38 architectures — every model in the new catalog is packing-eligible where applicable.
